slides.say: Matheus Cunha did a whole season in one night. Hero, or liability?
Manchester United were two nil down to Roma inside eighteen minutes.
Then Cunha took over. He won the penalty, scored the equaliser, and scored the winner.
Three two. United's first win in fifty four days. And then he got himself sent off.
So which is it? Hero, or liability?
Comment hero or liability, and send this to the United fan in your group.
